blocks.content: The Act provides for setting up Special Courts to conduct speedy trials of corruption cases.
The Act provides for setting up Special Courts to conduct speedy trials of corruption cases.

items: Special Courts are mandated specifically for speedy trials of corruption offences rather than standard judicial procedure timelines.
Exams frequently question the primary statutory purpose of Special Courts under corruption laws.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Act includes specific provisions for setting up Special Courts.
The primary objective of these Special Courts is to ensure the speedy trial of cases.
Jurisdiction of these Special Courts is dedicated to corruption cases.
